name: Research Project Proposal
description: Collaborative research proposal, simplified from the Horizon Europe structure: excellence, impact, implementation.

sections.title: Project Summary
sections.objective: Give evaluators the essence of the project on one page.

content.markdown:
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Acronym | [ACRONYM] |
| Full title | [Title] |
| Duration | [36 months] |
| Budget requested | [€ …] |
| Keywords | [k1, k2, k3] |

subs.title: Abstract
subs.objective: Written last; must stand alone for reviewers who read nothing else.

content.markdown: _Max 2000 characters: challenge, objectives, approach, expected impact._

sections.title: Introduction
sections.objective: Frame the challenge the project addresses and why it must be tackled now.

children.title: Challenge and Context
children.objective: Describe the societal, scientific or industrial challenge and its relevance to the call.

content.markdown: _Evidence of the problem (figures, policy documents), link to the call topic and expected outcomes._

children.title: Project Vision
children.objective: State in a few lines what the world looks like if the project succeeds.

content.markdown: _By the end of the project, [who] will be able to [what], thanks to [key result]._

sections.title: Excellence
sections.objective: Show that the objectives are clear and ambitious and that the methodology is sound.

children.title: Objectives
children.objective: Define specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound (SMART) objectives.

subs.title: Specific objectives
subs.objective: Every objective must map to work packages and deliverables.

content.markdown:
| ID | Objective | Measurable indicator | Target | Month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| O1 | [Develop …] | [Accuracy / TRL / users] | [value] | M18 |
| O2 | [Validate …] | [...] | [...] | M30 |
| O3 | [Demonstrate …] | [...] | [...] | M36 |

children.title: State of the Art and Beyond
children.objective: Summarise the state of the art and explain how the project advances beyond it.

subs.title: Progress beyond the state of the art

content.markdown:
| Area | State of the art | Limitations | Our advance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Area 1] | [Best existing approaches, cited] | [Gap] | [What the project brings] |
_Starting TRL [x] → target TRL [y], with justification._

children.title: Methodology
children.objective: Describe the concept, the approach and how the work is organised to reach the objectives.

content.code:
flowchart LR
  req[Requirements and use cases] --> res[Research and development]
  res --> int[Integration]
  int --> pil[Pilots and validation]
  pil -->|feedback| res
  pil --> exp[Exploitation]

content.markdown: _Methods, models, data, and how interdisciplinary expertise is combined. Explain alternatives and fallback strategies._

children.title: Open Science Practices
children.objective: Explain how results, data and software will be shared openly and reproducibly.

content.markdown:
- Open access publications: [route]
- Research data management: [FAIR principles, repositories]
- Open-source software: [licenses]

sections.title: Impact
sections.objective: Convince evaluators that results will lead to outcomes and wider impacts, and how they will reach users.

children.title: Pathways to Impact
children.objective: Link project outputs to expected outcomes and long-term impacts.

content.code:
flowchart LR
  out[Outputs: tools, datasets, publications] --> outc[Outcomes: adoption by target groups]
  outc --> imp[Impacts: societal, economic, scientific]

content.markdown:
| Expected outcome (call) | Project contribution | Indicator | Target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Outcome from the call text] | [How we contribute] | [KPI] | [value] |
